units.source_text: 冷泉帝身边有两个女御紧紧地夹侍左右，那兵部卿亲王便不能顺利地将女儿送进宫来。

en.t: With two consorts constantly attending close at Emperor Reizei's side, Prince Hyobukyo could not easily send his daughter into the palace.

units.source_text: 他相信皇上长大起来，虽然有了这两个女御，也不会抛弃他的女儿的，便静静地等候着。

en.t: He believed that once the emperor grew older, even with those two consorts, he would not abandon his daughter, and so he waited quietly.

units.source_text: 那两个女御便各尽所能，以争取宠幸。

en.t: The two consorts each did all they could to win the emperor's favor.
